results.title: Ever After
results.overview: On the eve of their wedding, a mature couple is waiting for the arrival of their adult children from previous marriages. But the reality is not what it seems.

results.title: Gasoline
results.overview: When Jacob stops by to comfort a broken-hearted Abraham, secrets and ulterior motives begin to unravel.

results.title: I Made The Invisible Man
results.overview: Victoria Griffin, a cynical ghostwriter, is hired to document the life of a man claiming to be H.G. Wells’ actual Invisible Man — but some truths refuse to stay buried.

results.title: Heading West
results.overview: Before saying farewell to their beloved hometown due to an impending nuclear power plant, a group of five enthusiastic young students embarks on a mission to create a film that will forever capture the precious memories of their neighborhood.

results.title: El amuleto
results.overview: A young man discovers a coin he believes has the power to change his fate, but soon learns that luck can be unpredictable.

results.title: Kamen Rider Gavv: Guilty Parfait
results.original_title: 仮面ライダーガヴ ギルティ・パルフェ
results.overview: After the events of the series, Shoma continues his research for "Light Treats" to replace Dark Treats, Hanto continues his research as a freelance writer as keep daily records of the battle of the Kamen Riders, and Rakia remains alone in the Granute World. However, a new incident occurs in the once peaceful human world, forcing Shoma to rush back to the battlefield. What serious abnormality has occured to Hanto's body? What is the current state of the president's daughter, Lizel Jaldak, who is stuck in the human world? The final battle of the candy Kamen Riders begin!

results.title: Mercy
results.overview: Based on the poetry cycle of the esteemed African-American poet Cornelius Eady, the film is inspired by the work of Phillis Wheatley, the first published black poet in the US. “Mercy” aims to weave Wheatley's poetry and imagery, which focuses on the complication of the slave learning their captor's language, with gesture, movement and voice into an intricate meditation on black womanhood.

results.title: A Flower Blooms In The Remains
results.overview: Audiovisual essay about walking through the streets of Lisbon. It explores discrimination and moving through spaces where one is not welcome.

results.title: Simple Plan: The Kids in the Crowd
results.original_title: Simple Plan: The Kids in the Crowd
results.overview: A captivating and nostalgic look at one of the most popular pop-punk bands of the 2000s. Packed with never-before-seen archival footage and exclusive access to their sold-out 2024 World Tour, the members of Simple Plan and a cast of punk-rock superstars recount the highs and lows of the first 25 years of their career. Stage-dive into a story of brotherhood, fans and resilience.

results.title: Varadouro
results.overview: Ítalo has a date with a man in an abandoned warehouse in Varadouro, but when he gets there he encounters other unexpected things.

results.title: Art Attack! The Dissection of Terrifier 3
results.original_title: Art Attack! The Dissection of Terrifier 3
results.overview: ART ATTACK. Dives into the making of Terrifier 3, exploring its shocking practical effects, Art the Clown's rise, and its bold impact on modern horror.

results.title: Soul of A Sister
results.overview: A singer with a once bright future falls victim to the music business at a young age. A decade later, despite an addiction and depression she rises up one more time with the help of a special friend and her God given gift of voice.

results.title: Dating Mark Silcox
results.overview: Unable to get a second date, Mark Silcox attempts to find love by learning to be funny. But could his joking go too far?

results.title: Breathing Underwater
results.overview: Within the school swimming club, teenagers question their sexuality and gender identity.

results.title: The Pirates of Penzance
results.overview: Recording of the 2025 run of the Pirates of Penzance by the Gilbert & Sullivan Opera Company in Chicago

results.title: Sibling Team 2
results.overview: Four siblings have successfully completed their parents' rigorous training and become true agents. The owner of a famous juice brand comes to them for help. The juice recipe has fallen into the hands of a villain who wants to make all the children unhappy with his secret concoction. This time, the entire family must work together for a challenging mission.

results.title: I am Bond, GG Bond
results.original_title: 猪猪侠·一只老猪的逆袭
results.overview: GG Bond, who once accompanied everyone's growth, has faded out of the audience's sight. After being out of fashion, he longs to become the protagonist again. With a strong desire to turn over the salted fish, he mobilized his entire body, but always made mistakes and had frequent bugs. Can GG Bond ultimately succeed in its comeback?
